_what: Every top-level entry in this repository is one of the two lists below. `site` is what GitHub Pages serves; `developer` is never published. tools/stage-site.js builds the published tree from this and FAILS on an entry in neither list, so a new file has to be classified on purpose: a new question bank that is not added here fails the build (the previous deployment stays live) instead of going missing from the site, and a new developer file cannot be published by default.
